name: Small Single Vertical Classic Bed
description:
The Essential Classic Wall Bed is a practical and durable space-saving solution designed for bedrooms, guest rooms and multifunctional spaces. Its strong steel frame and smooth gas-assisted lifting mechanism make it easy to open and close, while the fold-away design frees up valuable floor space when not in use.
Designed for simplicity and everyday use, the Essential Classic comes in a fixed bed size and opening configuration, with dedicated vertical and horizontal models available. Unlike the MORPHY™ range, Essential models do not feature SizeFlex or TypeFlex, making Essential the straightforward choice when you already know the size and orientation you need.
The Essential Classic can be used on its own, incorporated into custom cabinetry, or combined with our WallBedKing cabinet and matching side units to create a complete space-saving furniture solution. Available in a wide range of sizes, it accommodates a standard mattress up to approximately 30 cm thick.
